messages:
aj: Heads up — opened a PR to split provider namespaces in tf-modules. Need quick sanity check on secrets wiring + lockfile regen. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/482
cleo: on it. which envs will this touch? staging/prod?
aj: staging only for the first rollout, prod will follow after canary. Changes: hoist providers from module root into module/child and add provider aliasing.
ryan: quick glance — plan failed in CI with provider version mismatch: `failed to select provider version`
aj: yep saw that. I ran `terraform providers lock` locally but the lockfile diff is noisy. thinking to keep lockfile regen in separate commit. @cleo do you want to handle the secret path mapping? I moved secret key for db to `module.db.kubernetes_secret_name`
cleo: I can handle secret wiring. quick Q: did you also change k8s manifest to reference new secret name? We have some pods reading `DB_CREDENTIALS_SECRET`
aj: changed Deployment env var in module/db/k8s/deployment.yaml to `DB_CREDENTIALS_SECRET: module.db.kubernetes_secret_name` — snippet: ```yaml
env:
  - name: DB_CREDENTIALS_SECRET
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: ${kube_secret_name}
        key: credentials
```
maria: :eyes: CI log shows plan wants to replace a redis instance because provider alias wasn't set on resource `module.cache.aws_instance`
aj: that was expected — I added `providers = { aws = aws.child }` to the module block. To avoid replacement we can add lifecycle ignore_changes or do a state mv. opinions?
ryan: state mv is safer here. lifecycle can hide drift. If we're renaming the provider only, do `terraform state mv module.cache.aws_instance module.cache.aws_instance`? That won't help. We need to update provider meta in state — use `terraform state replace-provider 'registry.terraform.io/-/aws' 'registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws'`?
cleo: I can run a dry-state-move in staging. @aj leave a step-by-step in PR description for the ops run.
infra-bot: plan finished (staging): 1 to add, 2 to change, 1 to destroy — see https://ci/redwood/1234
aj: added steps in PR + separate lockfile regen commit. @maria can you review lockfile commit? it's big but should be mechanical.
maria: skimming. can we pin provider aws to 4.60.0 in root before we regen? avoids transient bumps.
aj: good call — I'll add a pinned provider requirement in `versions.tf` and re-run lock. pushing new commit now.
deploy-bot: deploy window reminder: staging deploy scheduled at 2024-12-02T22:00Z
cleo: LGTM for secret wiring, I'll run the state replace on staging after this passes. @aj please don't squash the history for the state-move commit.
aj: will keep separate commits. thanks team :thumbsup:
